negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI plastic skin, glossy 3D render sheen, digital cartoon, photorealistic human skin pores, smooth digital art, deformed mittens, modern postal van, asphalt road, neon lights, oversaturated colors
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion clay facial sculpture with broad joyful smile, prominent aquiline nose, and stylized pointed beard — AI often turns joyful expression into distorted or generic CGI teeth
handcrafted tweed flat cap and melange wool overcoat with fine crystalline snow dusting — AI tends to melt snow into blurry white paint strokes
detailed kraft paper envelope with stamped orange-red wax seal held in knitted mittens — AI frequently malforms wax seal geometry or mangles mitten thumbs
atmospheric European village street with warm incandescent lantern bokeh contrasting with cool falling snow — AI risks flattening the depth perspective
